mapper.select: select id as notificationId, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, like_count as likeCount, last_like_time as lastLikeTime from notification_like where receiver_id = #{receiverId} order by last_like_time desc
select id, content from statuses where id in #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select id, content from comments where id in #{id} and is_deleted = 0

select a.user_id as id, u.nickname, u.avatar, DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as likeTime from attitudes a join users u on a.user_id = u.id where a.target_type = #{targetType} and a.target_id = #{targetId} order by a.created_at desc limit 20
select target_type from attitudes where target_id = #{targetId} limit 1
select case when #{targetType} = 1 then (select user_id from statuses where id = #{targetId}) else (select user_id from comments where id = #{targetId}) end
mapper.insert: insert into notification_like(receiver_id, target_type, target_id, like_count, last_like_time, is_read, create_time) values(#{receiverId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, 1, NOW(), 0, NOW()) on duplicate key update like_count = like_count + 1, last_like_time = NOW(), is_read = 0
mapper.select: select id as notificationId, sender_id as senderId, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, comment_id as commentId, create_time as createTime, is_read as isRead from notification_comment where receiver_id = #{receiverId} order by create_time desc
select id, nickname, avatar from users where id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into notification_comment(receiver_id, sender_id, target_type, target_id, comment_id, is_read, create_time) values(#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{commentId}, 0, NOW())
